exodus.35.p1.b1.text: … These are the things that the LORD has commanded you to do:

exodus.35.p1.b2.text: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a Sabbath of complete rest to the LORD. …

exodus.35.p1.b3.text: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day.

exodus.35.p2.b4.text: … Let everyone whose heart is willing bring an offering to the LORD: gold, silver, and bronze;

exodus.35.p2.b5.text: Let every skilled craftsman among you come and make everything that the LORD has commanded:

exodus.35.p3.b6.text: Then the whole congregation of Israel withdrew from the presence of Moses.

exodus.35.p3.b7.text: And everyone whose heart stirred him and whose spirit prompted him came and brought an offering to the LORD for the work on the Tent of Meeting, for all its services, and for the holy garments.

exodus.35.p3.b8.text: So all who had willing hearts, both men and women, came and brought brooches and earrings, rings and necklaces, and all kinds of gold jewelry. …

exodus.35.p3.b9.text: And all who could present an offering of silver or bronze brought it as a contribution to the LORD. …

exodus.35.p4.b10.text: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun: blue, purple, or scarlet yarn, or fine linen.

exodus.35.p4.b11.text: And all the skilled women whose hearts were stirred spun the goat hair.

exodus.35.p4.b12.text: So all the men and women of the Israelites whose hearts prompted them brought a freewill offering to the LORD for all the work that the LORD through Moses had commanded them to do.

exodus.35.p5.b13.text: … See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

exodus.35.p5.b14.text: And He has filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship, …

exodus.35.p5.b15.text: And the LORD has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.

exodus.35.p5.b16.text: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work … as artistic designers of every kind of craft.
